description: PR #890 (tdoljyj/cross-memory-system) removes the retired clued-ci-home-linux-01 entry from the linux-route matrix of the ungated heartbeat workflow. Base is main fbb4a8d9, head is b86084a5. Owner Decision 586181ec.

base.text:
name: clued-ci-runner-heartbeat

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "*/15 * * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: clued-ci-runner-heartbeat
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  windows-route:
    name: runner-heartbeat / ${{ matrix.runner_name }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - runner_name: clued-ci-company-win-01
            site_label: site-company
          - runner_name: clued-ci-home-win-01
            site_label: site-home
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Windows, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal, cap-python312, "${{ matrix.site_label }}"]
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Verify exact runner route
        shell: powershell
        env:
          EXPECTED_RUNNER_NAME: ${{ matrix.runner_name }}
        run: |
          if ($env:RUNNER_NAME -ne $env:EXPECTED_RUNNER_NAME) {
            throw "Expected $env:EXPECTED_RUNNER_NAME but routed to $env:RUNNER_NAME"
          }
          Write-Output "Runner route verified: $env:RUNNER_NAME"

  linux-route:
    name: runner-heartbeat / ${{ matrix.runner_name }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          # site-company matches both company Linux slots, so company routes use
          # each runner's own route label; home has a single Linux runner.
          - runner_name: clued-ci-company-linux-01
            route_label: runner-company-linux-01
          - runner_name: clued-ci-company-linux-02
            route_label: runner-company-linux-02
          - runner_name: clued-ci-home-linux-01
            route_label: site-home
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal, cap-docker-linux, runtime-wsl2, "${{ matrix.route_label }}"]
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Verify exact runner route
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_RUNNER_NAME: ${{ matrix.runner_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "$RUNNER_NAME" != "$EXPECTED_RUNNER_NAME" ]]; then
            echo "Expected $EXPECTED_RUNNER_NAME but routed to $RUNNER_NAME" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Runner route verified: $RUNNER_NAME"
